ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the surface with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized distal tips and fine linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity contiguous field across the main body; high-contrast white geometric clusters at the terminal distal tips of both lobes; several thin, high-intensity linear traces distributed across the interior medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth occupying approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel amplitude of peaks varies from 3-12 pixels; most pronounced jaggedness occurs along the interior half of the trailing edges near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curvature transitioning to an upward-sweeping convex curve at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; a prominent vertical-leaning scratch is visible on the upper section of the right lobe, with smaller diagonal scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of multiple linear rake marks across the fluke surface and heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips.
